sources.title: HHS Finalizes HIPAA Privacy Rule Changes: What Every Healthcare Organization Needs to Know (K&L Gates)
excerpts: Cuts the deadline for acting on a request for copies of PHI from 30 to 15 calendar days.
Confirms that an individual may obtain electronic PHI through a personal health application.
Bars identity verification steps that impose unnecessary effort or expense.
Confirms that health plans may use and disclose PHI for care coordination and case management for specific individuals.
Expressly permits disclosures to social services agencies, community-based organizations, and similar third parties.

sources.title: White House pulls nomination for FDA nominee Overton (BioPharma Dive)
excerpts: The White House has pulled Heidi Overton's nomination to be the Food and Drug Administration's next commissioner.

sources.title: This Week: Senate HELP to vote on Overton, FDA shelves CNPV and more (RAPS)
